## Notes

Must be level 130 crafter and complete previous quests from the Shipwrecked timeline to get this quest.

## Steps

1. Harvest 200 resources from Zimara zones ([[Splendor Sky Aerie]], [[Zimara Breadth]], [[Aether Wroughtlands]])
1. Return to Rakira

## Rewards

- [[Jumpa Lope Plushie]]
- [[Zimaran Amalgamation]]
